decision: Did not close and did not instruct anyone. The landlord confirmed completion on 4 April (event-034) and the request was marked completed without payment (event-036, event-037), but 52 minutes later the landlord asked whether a new appointment date had been arranged with tenants (event-038) — so completion is no longer established and the playbook's final checks cannot be signed off. I asked the landlord to confirm whether the work is finished or a further visit is outstanding and which property event-038 refers to (ACT-1), asked the tenant whether a contractor has attended and whether anything remains outstanding (ACT-2), referred the seven conflicting addresses on this one job id to the office rather than picking a side in a message to a party (ACT-3, per ESC-CONFLICT routing to RTE-STAFF via a human task), recorded the chronology and the safety check (ACT-4) and placed the case on hold (ACT-5).
